title: Imagination Is More Important
simplified_paragraphs: 如果你必须和别人打架，你会选择一位普通人，还是一位空手道冠军？相信大部分的人会选择普通人。因为大家很清楚，空手道冠军很会打架。
但是在美国，有这样一个故事：有两个人因为一点儿小事打了起来，一个是普通人，另一个是有名的空手道冠军。几分钟后，结果出来了——空手道冠军输了。因为空手道冠军受到规则的束缚，不打头部，但是另一个人没有学过，重重地打了他的鼻子，然后他就站不起来了。
所以，想象力比知识更重要！
traditional_paragraphs: 如果你必須和別人打架，你會選擇一位普通人，還是一位空手道冠軍？相信大部分的人會選擇普通人。因為大家很清楚，空手道冠軍很會打架。
但是在美國，有這樣一個故事：有兩個人因為一點兒小事打了起來，一個是普通人，另一個是有名的空手道冠軍。幾分鐘後，結果出來了——空手道冠軍輸了。因為空手道冠軍受到規則的束縛，不打頭部，但是另一個人沒有學過，重重地打了他的鼻子，然後他就站不起來了。
所以，想象力比知識更重要！

english_paragraphs: If you had to fight someone, would you choose an ordinary person or a karate champion? Most people would probably choose the ordinary person, because everyone knows a karate champion is good at fighting.

But there is a story from the United States: two people got into a fight over something trivial. One was an ordinary person, and the other was a famous karate champion. A few minutes later, the result was clear—the karate champion had lost. The champion was constrained by the rules and would not strike the other person's head. But the ordinary person had never learned those rules. He punched the champion hard in the nose, and the champion could not get back up.
So imagination is more important than knowledge!
english_full:
If you had to fight someone, would you choose an ordinary person or a karate champion? Most people would probably choose the ordinary person, because everyone knows a karate champion is good at fighting.

But there is a story from the United States: two people got into a fight over something trivial. One was an ordinary person, and the other was a famous karate champion. A few minutes later, the result was clear—the karate champion had lost. The champion was constrained by the rules and would not strike the other person's head. But the ordinary person had never learned those rules. He punched the champion hard in the nose, and the champion could not get back up.

So imagination is more important than knowledge!
